WITH v AS (SELECT {{Table1.updatedRow?.id}}::uuid AS mid, {{'{' + [["k_tulostin","c9c3c6d5-2842-417a-959c-0a1fc500a133"],["k_laminaattori","3604c4fa-ea54-47ce-9ee5-4413418d1680"],["k_tasoleikkuri","c5999f30-4f80-4a4d-a43c-73d9d29d9c7b"],["k_rullaleikkuri","793ae5e9-5c91-45b6-8a96-d8552d983afe"],["k_laser","40ef558a-0e62-4033-8194-93676b474bee"],["k_prassi","6c104546-4c9c-4251-bcc6-6f61efa50290"]].filter(p => Table1.updatedRow?.[p[0]] === true).map(p => p[1]).join(',') + '}'}}::uuid[] AS ids),
del AS (DELETE FROM public.materiaali_koneet mk USING v WHERE mk.materiaali_id = v.mid AND NOT (mk.kone_id = ANY(v.ids))),
ins AS (INSERT INTO public.materiaali_koneet (materiaali_id, kone_id) SELECT v.mid, unnest(v.ids) FROM v ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING)
SELECT 1 AS ok;
